capabilities: encrypt notes and folders, including file names, with a password and optional hint
unlock notes to work in the normal editor and lock manually or after inactivity
decrypt permanently to restore real names and links
block renames so readable names never reach disk
keep links between encrypted notes and from other notes working
extras: Not yet listed in Obsidian's community plugins; manual installation required and it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only Markdown and Meld Encrypt notes are encrypted; other file types stay visible. Notes on limitations such as readable bookmarks, File recovery snapshots, and Obsidian Sync file-type settings.
intentEvidence: Meld Encrypt encrypts the content of notes; Folder Encrypt also encrypts their file names
problem: Obsidian stores notes and their names as plain files on disk, with no built-in way to hide note content or file names from anyone with file access.

relations.evidence: the file format and cryptography this plugin builds on

summary: Password-encrypts notes including their file names, or whole folders at once, keeping content decrypted only in memory.
